method.visualInspection: view_image on 11 sampled frames per clip at integer seconds 0 through 10, square original plus the centered 4:5 crop, and paired first/last endpoint sheets.
limits: Sampled visual inspection does not certify every intervening frame or detailed finger anatomy.
Audio was not listened to; only presence of one audio stream per source was verified.

commonObservations: Exactly two main foosball players remain visible during sampled frames; no disappearing or duplicated player observed.
The graphite foosball table keeps its dark field, red/black figures, straight rods and recognizable legs across the sampled travelling; no switch to a green field or transformation into a desk.
Both complete heads and interacting hands remain legible in 9:16 and centered 4:5. Peripheral body/table edges are tighter in 9:16, especially at the endpoints, but the main action is retained.
Blue glass meeting room remains behind/right, amber coffee counter behind/left; the camera retreat reveals more existing office without an obvious location change in the samples.
Green confirmation graphics become visible on office displays later in the shot; some are stylized angled marks rather than a perfectly identical glyph.
First frames closely match the first frames of the accepted scene 6 reverse sources (which become scene 6 final frames during export).
Last frames closely match the true accepted horizontal scene 7 final frame cropped at focusX 0.65.

integration.portrait: Use07-execution-portrait.mp4 for 9:16, normal forward picture/audio; match scene 8 initial focusX 0.65 before its approved smooth return to 0.50.
integration.square: Use07-execution-square.mp4 for 4:5, centered crop of its 1440×1440 image to 1152×1440 before scaling 1080×1350; match scene 8 initial focusX 0.65.
integration.endReference: Accepted07-execution.mp4 frame 240 at 10s, 1916×1080 source, cover crop focusX 0.65 / focusY 0.50. The square end target had source 1080×1080 at x575.8 then centered 4:5, equivalent to horizontal 4:5 cover crop.
integration.source6Portrait: clips/06-life-portrait-reverse.mp4 frame 0, normalized portrait center cover, job fc8b84f0-b326-4d44-a33a-66320ecc02c3

audioReview: Not listened; no assertion about dialogue, music, artifacts or sound transitions.
